text:
nora: quick note - the continuous-batcher tail looks like admission+coalesce coupling. proposing a small 'reservation broker' to mediate admission and a bounded overflow pond for tiny latency-sensitive requests.

sam: can you sketch the surfaces?

nora: callers -> broker.Reserve(tenant, hints) -> ReservedTicket or Reject. ticket contains lane (fast|coalesce), ttl, optional pond_token. broker owns per-tenant ledger and pond bounds. coalescer subscribes for ready tickets.

maya: pond should use age+seq_len priority; small reqs go there and get fastlane if pond latency < threshold.

devon: broker enforces pond size with hysteresis: tighten admission when pond_fill > hi, relax when < lo.

li: KV-warmup hook: mark prefix warm after N hits in Ms, emit prefix_warm event; broker adds warm score to credits.

sam: rollout: feature-flag on stage, replay problematic mix, measure per-tenant p50/p95/p99, formed_batch_size histogram, pond metrics.

infra-bot: feature-flag enabled on stage-rack-3 by sam at 2026-03-11T09:41:02Z :white_check_mark:

maya: if stage improves small-request p95 but large-request p99 degrades, tune pond thresholds and quotas.

nora: RFC plan: define broker contract, ticket lifecycle, metrics (ticket_reject_rate, pond_drop_rate, lane_switch_count, tenant_credit_balance, prefix_warm_ratio), compatibility shim, and rollout playbook. post Thu.

devon: add alert for sudden increase in late_join_formed_batch_size correlated with kvcache_miss_rate and pond_drop.

sam: running replay now; will upload artifacts.

nora: thanks all, closing loop - will draft RFC and link tickets.
